issues_detected.recommendation: Document acquisition methods and their relevant instruments or capture systems in acquisition or raw-source records, preserving modality and release scope.

issues_detected.description: The detailed MuSIC pipeline produces cell maps that the record states are absent from the current release, while FAIRSCAPE-CLI packages data and metadata. Neither establishes processing or processing software for the distributed assay data.
issues_detected.recommendation: Describe the actual transformations applied to each distributed assay stream and name the software that performed those transformations.

issues_detected.description: The record does not explicitly document sensitive content or content-warning status.
issues_detected.recommendation: State whether sensitive or warning-worthy content is present, including an explicit negative statement when supported.

issues_detected.description: The recognized repository is named in root prose, but the rubric-declared publisher field is absent.
issues_detected.recommendation: Populate root publisher metadata consistently with the supported repository and publishing information already documented.

issues_detected.description: The NIH project period ends on 2026-08-31, while the maintenance statement describes the project ending in November 2026. These may concern different commitments, but their relationship is not explained.
issues_detected.recommendation: Distinguish the award period from the maintenance commitment or document any supported extension.

semantic_insights: The root explicitly describes a release series. Child versions, citations, DOIs, and file metadata were retained in their actual locations rather than promoted to root fields.
The purpose, multimodal design, cell systems, funding, licensing, and intended uses form a coherent account of functional-genomics research.
A governance contact meaningfully supports regulatory-contact documentation, but does not establish an ethics review or impact assessment.
The software discussion explicitly distinguishes unreleased cell-map processing from release packaging, preventing those tools from being credited as released-data processing software.
Different imaging-protein counts are attributed to different releases or page snapshots; they were not treated as contradictory counts of one identical release.
The representativeness limitation is substantively categorized in prose even without a separate bias_type value.
The record's false human-subjects flag was treated as populated evidence. It did not establish non-applicability because the independent caller applicability context is empty.
Collection and processing dates are insufficient to establish a complete collection-to-publication chronology; available creation and publication dates do not show reversed ordering.
